generation.desc.depth_first: Controls corridor shape: low values give short, winding passages; high values give long, straight corridors.
generation.desc.corridor_chance: Controls how often passages are narrow corridors versus open junctions with multiple branches.
generation.desc.branching: Controls how wide junctions are. Low values keep junctions simple; high values create wider junctions with more branches.
generation.desc.directionality: Controls how often the maze continues straight ahead instead of turning, making corridors feel more linear.
generation.desc.cyclicity: Controls how often extra connections are added that create loops in the maze, instead of a single branching path.
generation.desc.corridor_length: Controls how long corridors tend to be before the maze branches off in a new direction.
generation.desc.one_way_chance: Controls how often a plain passage between two cells is one-way instead of two-way.
generation.desc.teleport_chance: Controls how often a teleport edge is added, connecting two cells that aren't spatially adjacent.
generation.desc.teleport_one_way_chance: Controls how often a teleport edge is one-way instead of two-way.
generation.desc.cross_floor_teleport_bal: On multi-floor mazes, balances whether a teleport target is preferred on another floor (right) or the same floor (left).
generation.desc.split_chance: Controls how often a growth step turns a cell into a split node instead of a plain cell.
generation.desc.vertical_chance: On multi-floor mazes, controls how often a growth step attempts a vertical connection (passage or elevator) to another floor.
generation.desc.vertical_passage_elevato: Balances whether a vertical connection becomes a single-floor passage (left) or a multi-floor elevator (right).
generation.desc.one_way_vertical_passage: Controls how often a vertical passage between two floors is one-way instead of two-way.
generation.desc.vertical_up_down_balance: For one-way vertical passages, balances whether the passage goes down (left) or up (right).
generation.desc.elevator_span: Minimum and maximum number of floors an elevator connects, including its starting floor.
generation.desc.elevator_branching: Controls how often an elevator grows beyond its minimum floor count, up to its maximum.
generation.desc.allow_non_consecutive_el: When off, an elevator only connects a contiguous run of floors. When on, it may skip floors.

algorithm.desc.custom_vertex_based: A configurable algorithm that builds mazes by traversing vertices. Supports depth-first exploration, corridor chance, branching factor, and directional bias. Produces a wide variety of maze styles depending on parameters. Fully configurable and can organically generate non-standard elements, such as one-ways, teleports, splits, and vertical passages, as part of generation itself, rather than only through post-generation quality rules.
algorithm.desc.recursive_backtracker: Classic depth-first search maze generator. Produces mazes with long winding corridors and low branching. Guaranteed perfect maze (single solution). No configurable parameters.
algorithm.desc.wilson_algorithm: Generates a uniformly random spanning tree using loop-erased random walks. Every possible perfect maze is equally likely. Slower on large fields but produces statistically unbiased results. No configurable parameters.
algorithm.desc.kruskal_algorithm: Generates a minimum spanning tree by randomly merging disjoint sets. Produces mazes with many short passages and high branching. No configurable parameters.

check.max_loops_count.description: Fires if the field has more simple loops than allowed. Every loop is flagged when the maximum is exceeded.

check.scc_count.description: Fires if the graph is split into more strongly-connected regions than the allowed maximum, signalling a fragmented maze.

check.min_region_ratio.label: Min SCC ratio

check.max_region_size.label: Max SCC size
check.max_region_size.description: Fires if any strongly-connected region has more tiles than the allowed maximum.
check.max_region_ratio.label: Max SCC ratio
check.max_region_ratio.description: Fires if any strongly-connected region covers more than the allowed share of the field.

check.teleport_group_proximity.label: Group proximity

check.one_way_waypoint_distance.label: One-way waypoint distance
check.one_way_waypoint_distance.descript: Fires if a one-way passage edge's logical distance (either endpoint, whichever is closer) to start and/or finish compares against the configured threshold.

check.min_teleport_ratio.description: Fires if the maze has fewer teleports than the required minimum, expressed per 100 field cells (not per 100 edges).
check.split_distance_from_waypoint.label: Distance from waypoint
check.split_distance_from_waypoint.descr: Fires if an extra split node's point sits too close to (or, with a different comparison, too far from) start and/or finish in logical distance.
check.split_teleport_intersection.label: Split teleport intersection
check.split_teleport_intersection.descri: Fires if a split tile has a teleport connection matching the configured shape (one-way in, one-way out, or bidirectional).

check.split_pattern_shape.description: Fires if a split tile's current shape no longer structurally matches any pattern in this check's own pattern list (e.g. after a later repair strategy removed one of its nodes/connections).

param.min_loops.label: Min loop count
param.min_loops.description: The minimum number of loops the maze must contain.
param.length.label: Length threshold
param.length.description: The tile-length (or geometric distance) threshold this check's comparison operator applies against.
param.comparison.label: Comparison
param.comparison.description: The condition that fails the check: how the measured value must relate to the threshold for the check to report an issue.
param.cycle_kind.label: Cycle kind
param.cycle_kind.description: Restricts which cycles this check evaluates by directionality.
param.cycle_kind.option.any.explanation: Every cycle is evaluated, regardless of directionality.
param.cycle_kind.option.two_way.explanat: Only cycles where every edge is bidirectional (backed by a reverse edge) are evaluated.
param.cycle_kind.option.one_way.explanat: Only cycles containing at least one edge with no reverse are evaluated.
param.floor_mode.label: Floor mode
param.floor_mode.description: How a pair on different floors is treated, since each floor has its own independent coordinate system.
param.floor_mode.option.ignore.explanati: Floor is ignored; distance is the plain x-y distance, as if both points were on the same floor.
param.floor_mode.option.as_coordinate.ex: Floor difference is folded into the distance as a third coordinate (1.0 per floor).
A cross-floor pair always passes the check; distance is only evaluated for pairs on the same floor.
param.floor_scope.label: Scope
param.floor_scope.description: Whether the threshold is evaluated over the whole maze or independently per floor.
param.floor_scope.option.whole_maze.expl: The threshold is evaluated once over the entire maze, across all floors combined.
param.floor_scope.option.per_floor.expla: The threshold is evaluated independently for each floor; an entity spanning multiple floors counts toward every floor it touches.
param.min_distinct_exits.label: Min exits
param.min_distinct_exits.description: The minimum number of distinct places a loop must connect to outside itself.
param.min_distance_from_start.label: Min distance from start
param.min_distance_from_start.descriptio: How far (in tiles) a loop must be from the start before it's allowed.
param.min_distance_from_finish.label: Min distance from finish
param.min_distance_from_finish.descripti: How far (in tiles) a loop must be from the finish before it's allowed.
param.max_density.label: Max loop density (per 100 cells)
param.max_density.description: The maximum share of the maze that loops are allowed to cover.
param.max_loops_count.label: Max loop count
param.max_loops_count.description: The maximum number of simple loops allowed in the maze.
param.min_density.label: Min loop density (per 100 cells)
param.min_density.description: The minimum share of the maze that loops must cover.
param.avg_loop_length_estimate.label: Average loop length estimate
param.avg_loop_length_estimate.descripti: An estimate of typical loop size, used to figure out how many loops are needed to reach the target density.
param.path_weight.label: Path step weight
param.path_weight.description: How much the path length from start to finish raises the route's score.
param.junction_weight.label: Junction weight
param.junction_weight.description: How much the number of junctions on the path raises the route's score.
param.oneway_weight.label: One-way weight
param.oneway_weight.description: How much passing through one-way passages (including, for example, teleports) raises the route's score.
param.cross_floor_weight.label: Cross-floor weight
param.cross_floor_weight.description: How much crossing a floor boundary raises the route's score.
param.vertical_passage_weight.label: Vertical passage weight
param.vertical_passage_weight.descriptio: How much crossing a vertical passage raises the route's score.
param.split_weight.label: Split tile weight
param.split_weight.description: How much passing through split tiles raises the route's score.

param.valid_overlap_weight.label: Shared valid-loop penalty

param.reserve_percent.label: Reserve percent
param.reserve_percent.description: Extra connection attempts added on top of the minimum needed, as a safety margin in case some attempts fail.

param.min_region_ratio.label: Min region ratio (%)

param.locality.label: Growth directionality

param.target_mode.label: Target selection mode
param.target_mode.description: How to pick which neighboring region to merge the undersized region into.
param.target_mode.option.largest.explana: Merges into the biggest neighboring region.
param.target_mode.option.smallest.explan: Merges into the smallest neighboring region.
param.target_mode.option.random.explanat: Merges into any neighboring region, picked at random.
param.target_mode.option.prefer_needy.ex: Prefers a neighboring region that is also undersized; falls back to a random neighbor if none are.
param.connection_mode.label: Connection mode
param.connection_mode.description: How to bridge the undersized region into its neighbor.
param.connection_mode.option.passage.exp: Adds a full bidirectional passage across a shared wall.
param.connection_mode.option.one_way.exp: Adds two separate one-way edges (in and out) through different walls instead of a single passage.
param.prefer_partially_connected.label: Prefer partially connected neighbors
param.prefer_partially_connected.descrip: When choosing a neighboring region, prefer one that already has a one-way edge to or from the flagged region — completing it instead of starting a fresh connection elsewhere.

strategy.no_fix.label: Logging
strategy.no_fix.description: Records the issue in the report without attempting to fix it. This is the base behavior — it's what happens automatically whenever a rule's fix strategy is disabled, so it can't be disabled itself.
strategy.random_endpoints.label: Random endpoints
strategy.random_endpoints.description: Places start and finish at random nodes in the maze.
strategy.farthest_endpoints.label: Farthest endpoints
strategy.farthest_endpoints.description: Places start and finish at two nodes with a large path distance between them. Uses a fast heuristic (double path-search sweep) rather than an exhaustive search over all pairs — on graphs with cycles it can pick a pair slightly short of the true maximum.
strategy.scored_endpoints.label: Scored endpoints
strategy.scored_endpoints.description:
For each candidate pair, finds the shortest path between them and scores that exact path by length, junction count, one-way passage count and other parameters, then picks the pair with the best score. While this strategy is enabled, the resulting route's score is also shown in the analytics panel's Path section.

The same path element can score under several weights at once: for example, a one-way cross-floor teleport earns points for path step weight, one-way weight, cross-floor weight, and teleport weight all at the same time.
strategy.invalid_loop_random.label: Random loop break
strategy.invalid_loop_random.description: Breaks each invalid loop by removing one random passage from it.
strategy.invalid_loop_scored.label: Overlap-scored loop break
strategy.invalid_loop_scored.description: Breaks each invalid loop by removing the passage that overlaps the most other invalid loops while overlapping the fewest valid loops.
param.vertical_passage_priority.label: Vertical passage priority
param.vertical_passage_priority.descript: How vertical passages are treated among the candidates for the cut.
param.vertical_passage_priority.option.p: A vertical passage is cut whenever the loop contains one, even if other candidates exist.
param.vertical_passage_priority.option.n: Vertical passages are treated like any other passage.
strategy.invalid_loop_group_select.label: Loop selection and break
strategy.invalid_loop_group_select.descr: Picks one flagged loop (at random, or the shortest/longest) and delegates breaking it to a nested loop-breaking strategy.
strategy.missing_loops_random.label: Random loop seeding
strategy.missing_loops_random.descriptio: Adds random bidirectional passages (with a configurable reserve margin) and lets the next quality control pass discard the ones that don't form a valid loop.
strategy.missing_loops_vertical.label: Vertical loop seeding
strategy.missing_loops_vertical.descript: Adds random vertical passages (with a configurable reserve margin) between adjacent floors and lets the next quality control pass discard the ones that don't form a valid loop.
strategy.missing_loops_split.label: Loop seeding via split
strategy.missing_loops_split.description: Closes a loop by turning a randomly chosen cell into a split tile, wiring one of its nodes to a geometric neighbor as a bridge, and lets the next quality control pass discard the ones that don't form a valid loop. Freely rebuilds the cell's other connections in the process — dropping existing ones and adding new ones as needed to fit the split — not just dividing them between the new nodes as-is.
strategy.missing_loops_teleport.label: Teleport loop seeding
strategy.missing_loops_teleport.descript: Adds random teleport connections and lets the next quality control pass discard the ones that don't form a valid loop.
strategy.priority_missing_loops.label: Priority-fallback loop seeding
strategy.priority_missing_loops.descript: Tries several nested missing-loops strategies in the order they're configured; if one fails, falls through to the next one until one succeeds or every candidate has been tried.
strategy.expand_region_passage.label: Region expansion via passage
strategy.expand_region_passage.descripti: Merges an undersized region into a neighboring region by adding a full bidirectional passage across a shared wall.
strategy.teleport_region_merge.label: Region expansion via teleport
strategy.teleport_region_merge.descripti: Merges an undersized region into a neighboring region via a teleport edge — the two regions don't need to be geometrically adjacent.
strategy.region_shrink_split.label: Region split
strategy.region_shrink_split.description: Splits an oversized region into two roughly equal-sized regions by cutting the passages between them, never touching preset connections or the current start-finish route.
strategy.missing_regions.label: Missing region growth or reuse
strategy.missing_regions.description: Reuses an existing region or grows a new one from a seed, then converts it into the needed region class by adding or removing one-way passages.
strategy.reduce_scc_count.label: Region merge for count reduction
strategy.reduce_scc_count.description: Picks the regions to merge (by size or at random) until the region count reaches the configured maximum, then delegates the actual merge to a nested strategy.
strategy.remove_teleport.label: Teleport removal
strategy.remove_teleport.description: Removes each teleport flagged invalid by a per-teleport validation check — or, with "Allow teleport to become one-way" enabled, downgrades it to one-way instead of removing it entirely.
strategy.add_teleport.label: Teleport addition
strategy.add_teleport.description: Adds a teleport to repair the reported issue.
strategy.weighted_region_merge.label: Weighted random region merge
strategy.weighted_region_merge.descripti: Picks one of several nested region-merge strategies at random, weighted by each one's configured weight; if the chosen one fails, retries a different one (still weighted) until one succeeds or every candidate has been tried.
strategy.priority_region_merge.label: Priority-fallback region merge
strategy.priority_region_merge.descripti: Tries several nested region-merge strategies in the order they're configured; if one fails, falls through to the next one until one succeeds or every candidate has been tried.
strategy.teleport_group_select.label: Teleport group selection
strategy.teleport_group_select.descripti: For each flagged group of excess or too-close teleports, picks some down to the configured budget and delegates their actual removal to a nested strategy.
strategy.one_way_to_passage.label: Convert to passage
strategy.one_way_to_passage.description: Converts each one-way edge flagged invalid into a full bidirectional passage by adding the missing reverse direction.
strategy.one_way_to_wall.label: Convert to wall
strategy.one_way_to_wall.description: Removes each one-way edge flagged invalid entirely, turning it into a wall.
strategy.one_way_group_select.label: One-way group select
strategy.one_way_group_select.descriptio: For each flagged group of one-way edges, picks one to fix and delegates the actual fix to a nested strategy.
strategy.missing_one_ways_from_passage.d: Picks random existing bidirectional passages and downgrades each to a one-way. On the maze's current start-finish route, the route's own direction is always kept; elsewhere the removed direction is random.
strategy.missing_one_ways_from_wall.desc: Picks random disconnected pairs of adjacent cells (walls) and adds a single directed edge between them at random, turning the wall into a one-way.
strategy.missing_teleports.label: Random teleport
strategy.missing_teleports.description: Adds the full computed count of missing teleport edges in one pass, picking an entry node and matching exit distance for each.
strategy.remove_split.label: Split tile removal
strategy.remove_split.description: Collapses each flagged extra split node back into the original node — optionally redistributing its connections to the original node instead of dropping them.
strategy.split_group_select.label: Split group select
strategy.split_group_select.description: For each flagged group of extra split nodes, picks one to collapse and delegates the actual collapse to a nested strategy.
strategy.add_split.label: Add split tiles
strategy.add_split.description: Mints new split tiles at randomly chosen eligible points until the required count is reached, either from a configured pattern list or in unconstrained mode.
strategy.remove_split_node.label: Split node removal
strategy.remove_split_node.description: Removes each flagged split node entirely — optionally redistributing its connections to another remaining node of the same split, picked at random, instead of dropping them.
strategy.remove_split_node_connection.de: Removes a single flagged connection from a split node — the nested target every split node connection group select delegates one candidate's removal to.
strategy.split_node_connection_group_sel: For each flagged group of excess split-node connections, picks connections to cut down to the configured cap and delegates each actual removal to a nested strategy.
strategy.split_node_group_select.label: Split node group select
strategy.split_node_group_select.descrip: For each flagged over-limit split tile, picks nodes to remove down to the configured limit and delegates each actual removal to a nested strategy — never selects the tile's original (slot-0) node.
strategy.split_route_cut.label: Split route cut
strategy.split_route_cut.description: For each flagged too-short route between two nodes of the same split tile, picks one edge along the route to cut — delegating a split-tile edge's removal to a nested strategy, cutting any other edge itself.
strategy.add_vertical_passage.label: Random vertical passage
strategy.add_vertical_passage.descriptio: Adds the full computed count of missing vertical passage edges in one pass, picking a random node whose adjacent floor resolves a target for each.
strategy.remove_vertical_passage.label: Vertical passage removal
strategy.remove_vertical_passage.descrip: Removes each vertical passage flagged invalid by a per-vertical-passage validation check.
strategy.vertical_passage_group_select.d: For each flagged group of excess or too-close vertical passages, removes one down to the configured budget and delegates each actual removal to a nested strategy.
strategy.remove_elevator.label: Remove elevator
strategy.remove_elevator.description: Removes every edge of a flagged elevator.
Replaces a flagged elevator with a chain of vertical passages, removing the original elevator edges.
strategy.elevator_group_select.label: Elevator group selection
strategy.elevator_group_select.descripti: For each flagged group of excess elevators, picks one down to the configured budget and delegates its actual removal to a nested strategy.
strategy.elevator_stop_group_select.desc: For each flagged group of problematic elevator stops (excess stop count, or a skip/span violation), picks one down to the configured budget and delegates its actual removal to a nested strategy.
strategy.remove_elevator_stop.label: Remove elevator stop
strategy.remove_elevator_stop.descriptio: Removes a single flagged stop from its elevator, leaving the rest of the elevator intact.
strategy.add_elevator.label: Add elevator
strategy.add_elevator.description: Builds new elevators to close a missing-elevator deficit — for each, picks a floor span and stop count within the configured ranges, then places stops within that span honoring the configured skip range.
strategy.add_elevator_stop.label: Add stops to maze
strategy.add_elevator_stop.description: Either builds a new elevator (via a nested add-elevator strategy) or reuses an existing elevator and gives it a new stop, chosen by the configured existing-reuse balance, falling back to the other branch on failure.
strategy.add_elevator_stop_count.label: Add elevator stop
strategy.add_elevator_stop_count.descrip: Adds stops to an existing elevator, picking random available floors.
strategy.add_elevator_height_stop.label: Add height stop
strategy.add_elevator_height_stop.descri: Extends an elevator upward and downward until it reaches the required height.
strategy.add_elevator_stop_for_gap.label: Add stop in gap
strategy.add_elevator_stop_for_gap.descr: Adds a stop between an elevator's two farthest-apart stops to close an excessive gap.
strategy.vertical_passage_region_merge.d: Merges an undersized region into a neighboring floor via a vertical passage, either a full two-way passage or a pair of one-way edges.
strategy.elevator_region_merge.label: Elevator region merge
strategy.elevator_region_merge.descripti: Merges an undersized region into another region on a different floor via an elevator, spanning exactly two floors -- either a brand-new elevator or an added stop on an existing one.
strategy.cross_element_group_select.desc: For each flagged pair of special elements that sit too close, picks one and delegates its removal to a per-type nested strategy (teleport, one-way, vertical passage, elevator stop, or split tile). An elevator-stop fix removes only the offending stop, not the whole elevator. Start and finish are never removed.
param.redistribute.label: Redistribute connections
param.redistribute.description: If enabled, the removed split node's connections are reconnected to the original node instead of simply disappearing with it.
param.entry_pick.label: Entry pick
param.entry_pick.description: How the teleport's entry node is chosen.
param.entry_pick.option.random.explanati: Picks a uniformly random field node as entry.
param.entry_pick.option.farthest_from_ra: Picks a random node, then the farthest node forward-reachable from it, as entry.
param.entry_pick.option.dead_end_priorit: Picks a random entry biased toward dead-end nodes, preferring them over other candidates when any are available.
param.unreachable_priority.label: Unreachable area priority
param.unreachable_priority.description: Whether a teleport's exit should be picked from a node currently unreachable from entry (e.g. in another strongly-connected component) or one at the desired distance.
param.unreachable_priority.option.forbid: The exit is only picked from nodes at the desired distance; this entry attempt fails if none qualify.
param.unreachable_priority.option.discou: The exit is picked from nodes at the desired distance first, falling back to an unreachable node only if none qualify.
param.unreachable_priority.option.indiff: The exit is picked at random regardless of whether the node is at the desired distance or currently unreachable.
param.unreachable_priority.option.prefer: The exit is picked from a currently unreachable node first, falling back to one at the desired distance only if none qualify.
param.unreachable_priority.option.requir: The exit is only picked from a currently unreachable node; this entry attempt fails if none qualify.
param.desired_length.label: Desired graph length
param.desired_length.description: Tile-hop distance range from entry an exit node should fall within.
param.allow_out_of_interval.label: Allow out-of-interval teleport
param.allow_out_of_interval.description: If no preferred exit falls within the desired length, allow picking an exit outside the interval instead of failing.
param.one_way_chance.label: One-way teleport chance
param.one_way_chance.description: Chance that the reverse edge is not added, leaving the teleport one-directional.
param.loop_one_way_chance.label: Loop one-way chance
param.loop_one_way_chance.description: Chance that a newly seeded connection is added as a single one-way edge instead of a full bidirectional passage.
param.vertical_loop_one_way_chance.label: Loop one-way chance
param.vertical_loop_one_way_chance.descr: Chance that a newly seeded vertical connection is added as a single one-way edge instead of a full bidirectional passage.
param.teleport_loop_one_way_chance.label: Teleport loop one-way chance
param.teleport_loop_one_way_chance.descr: Chance that a newly seeded teleport is added as a single one-way edge instead of a full bidirectional teleport.
param.vertical_direction_balance.label: Direction balance
param.vertical_direction_balance.descrip: The probability a newly seeded vertical passage goes up rather than down.
param.attempts_limit.label: Attempts limit
param.attempts_limit.description: How many entry candidates to try before giving up on a single teleport.
param.selection_mode.label: Target loop selection
param.selection_mode.description: Which flagged loop to pick for breaking.
param.selection_mode.option.shortest.exp: Picks the flagged loop with the fewest passages.
param.selection_mode.option.longest.expl: Picks the flagged loop with the most passages.
param.sample_mode.label: Sample size mode
param.sample_mode.description: Whether the sample size below is an absolute count or a percentage of flagged loops.
param.sample_mode.option.count.explanati: Sample size is an absolute number of loops.
param.sample_mode.option.percent.explana: Sample size is a percentage of all flagged loops.
param.sample_size.label: Sample size
param.sample_size.description: How many flagged loops to resolve per repair pass — an absolute count or a percentage, per the sample size mode. Always at least 1.
param.merge_priority.label: Merge priority
param.merge_priority.description: Which regions to pick for merging first.
param.distance.label: Distance threshold
param.distance.description: Logical (tile) distance threshold the check compares against, per the selected comparison operator.
param.distance.cross_element_proximity.d: Minimum allowed distance, in tiles, between the selected elements. There is no comparison operator: any pair closer than this is flagged.
param.waypoint.label: Waypoint
param.waypoint.description: Which waypoint(s) the distance is measured against.
param.waypoint.option.start.explanation: Measures distance from the maze's start only.
param.waypoint.option.finish.explanation: Measures distance from the maze's finish only.
param.waypoint.option.any.explanation: Uses whichever of start or finish is closer.
param.edge.label: Edge
param.edge.description: Which end(s) of the teleport the distance is measured from.
param.edge.option.entry_only.explanation: Only the teleport's entry point is checked.
param.edge.option.entry_or_exit.explanat: The teleport is flagged if either its entry or its exit is too close.
param.edge_hub.label: Edge
param.edge_hub.description: Which end(s) of the teleport's vertex is checked for an excessive outgoing-connection count.
param.edge_hub.option.entry.explanation: Only the teleport's entry vertex is checked.
param.edge_hub.option.exit.explanation: Only the teleport's exit vertex is checked.
param.edge_hub.option.entry_or_exit.expl: The teleport is flagged if either its entry or its exit vertex exceeds the max connection count.
param.edge_split.label: Edge
param.edge_split.description: Which end(s) of the teleport's vertex is checked for split-cell membership.
param.edge_split.option.entry.explanatio: Only the teleport's entry vertex is checked.
param.edge_split.option.exit.explanation: Only the teleport's exit vertex is checked.
param.edge_split.option.entry_or_exit.ex: The teleport is flagged if either its entry or its exit vertex belongs to a split cell.
param.own_edge.label: This teleport's end
param.own_edge.description: Which end of the teleport being scanned is measured.
param.own_edge.option.entry.explanation: Measures from the teleport's entry point.
param.own_edge.option.exit.explanation: Measures from the teleport's exit point.
param.own_edge.option.entry_or_exit.expl: Uses whichever of the teleport's entry or exit is closer.
param.other_edge.label: Other teleport's end
param.other_edge.description: Which end of the other teleport in the pair is measured.
param.other_edge.option.entry.explanatio: Measures against the other teleport's entry point.
param.other_edge.option.exit.explanation: Measures against the other teleport's exit point.
param.other_edge.option.entry_or_exit.ex: Uses whichever of the other teleport's entry or exit is closer.
param.priority.label: Removal priority
param.priority.description: Which element of a problematic set to remove.
param.edge_scope.label: Cuttable edges
param.edge_scope.description: Which edges of a flagged route are eligible to be cut.
param.edge_scope.option.split_only.expla: Only considers edges leading to the split tile itself.
param.edge_scope.option.other_only.expla: Only considers edges not leading to the split tile. Leaves the split tile's own connections untouched.
param.priority.split_route_cut.descripti: Which passage of the route to remove.
param.priority.split_route_cut.option.ra: Removes a random passage from the flagged route.
param.priority.split_route_cut.option.pr: Removes whichever passage occurs in the most other flagged routes.
param.edge_scope.option.any.explanation: Considers every edge on the route.
param.protect_route.label: Protect start-finish route
param.protect_route.description: Never touch a connection that lies on the maze's current start-finish route.
param.min_one_ways.label: Min one-way count
param.min_one_ways.description: The minimum number of one-way passages the maze must contain.
param.min_ratio.label: Min one-way count (per 100 cells)
param.min_ratio.description: The minimum number of one-way passages the maze must contain, expressed per 100 field cells.
param.max_one_ways.label: Max one-way count
param.max_one_ways.description: The maximum number of one-way passages the maze may contain.
param.max_ratio.label: Max one-way count (per 100 cells)
param.max_ratio.description: The maximum number of one-way passages the maze may contain, expressed per 100 field cells.
param.min_teleports.label: Min teleport count
param.min_teleports.description: The minimum number of teleports the maze must contain.
param.min_teleport_ratio.label: Min teleport count (per 100 cells)
param.min_teleport_ratio.description: The minimum number of teleports the maze must contain, expressed per 100 field cells.
param.min_vertical_passages.label: Min vertical passage count
param.min_vertical_passages.description: The minimum number of vertical passages the maze must contain.
param.min_vertical_passage_ratio.label: Min vertical passage count (per 100 cells)
param.min_vertical_passage_ratio.descrip: The minimum number of vertical passages the maze must contain, expressed per 100 field cells.
param.max_vertical_passages.label: Max vertical passage count
param.max_vertical_passages.description: The maximum number of vertical passages the maze may contain.
param.one_way_balance.label: One-way passage balance
param.one_way_balance.description: The probability a newly added vertical passage is one-way rather than two-way.
param.direction_balance.label: Direction balance
param.direction_balance.description: The probability a newly added vertical passage goes up rather than down.
param.same_type_only.label: Same type only
param.same_type_only.description: If enabled, a pair is only compared when both vertical passages are the same type.
param.passage_type.label: Type
param.passage_type.description: Which logical vertical passages to count.
param.passage_type.option.any.explanatio: Counts every logical vertical passage, one-way or two-way alike.
param.passage_type.option.two_way.explan: Counts only passages that work in both directions.
param.passage_type.option.one_way.explan: Counts only one-way passages, in either direction.
param.passage_type.option.one_way_down.e: Counts only one-way passages going down.
param.passage_type.option.one_way_up.exp: Counts only one-way passages going up.
param.count_incoming.label: Count incoming
param.count_incoming.description: Only matters for one-way passages under per-floor scope: when off, a passage counts only toward the floor it starts from; when on, it also counts toward the floor it leads to.
param.teleport_direction.label: Direction
param.teleport_direction.description: Which teleport portals to count, filtered by directionality.
param.teleport_direction.option.any.expl: Counts every teleport portal, one-way or two-way alike.
param.teleport_direction.option.bidirect: Counts only portals that work in both directions.
param.teleport_floor_kind.label: Floor kind
param.teleport_floor_kind.description: Which teleport portals to count, filtered by whether they cross floors.
param.teleport_floor_kind.option.any.exp: Counts every teleport portal, same-floor or inter-floor alike.
param.teleport_floor_kind.option.inter_f: Counts only portals whose two ends are on different floors.
param.teleport_floor_kind.option.same_fl: Counts only portals whose two ends share a floor.
param.adjacent_floors_only.label: Adjacent floors only
param.adjacent_floors_only.description: When on, connects only the elevator's own stops as consecutive passages. When off, connects every floor from the bottommost to the topmost stop, skipping floors with no node at that point.
param.span.label: Span threshold
param.span.description: The elevator's inter-stop vertical distance (topmost minus bottommost stop) compared against this threshold.
param.allow_reverse.label: Allow teleport to become one-way
param.allow_reverse.description: Instead of removing a flagged teleport entirely, remove only the flagged direction — a two-way teleport becomes one-way.
param.max_split_count.label: Max count
param.max_split_count.description: The maximum number of split tiles the field may contain.
param.max_split_density.label: Max density (per 100 cells)
param.max_split_density.description: The maximum share of field cells that may carry a split tile, expressed per 100 field cells.
param.max_elevator_count.label: Max count
param.max_elevator_count.description: The maximum number of elevators the maze may contain.
param.max_elevator_density.label: Max density (per 100 cells)
param.max_elevator_density.description: The maximum share of field cells that may carry an elevator, expressed per 100 field cells.
param.split_group_geometric_proximity_di: Geometric (Euclidean, unit tile scale) distance threshold two split tiles must keep between each other.
param.split_group_graph_proximity_distan: Topological (tile-hop) distance threshold two split tiles must keep between each other.
param.split_count.label: Min count
param.split_count.description: The minimum number of split tiles the field must contain.
param.split_density.label: Min density (per 100 cells)
param.split_density.description: The minimum share of field cells that must carry a split tile, expressed per 100 field cells.
param.split_patterns.label: Split patterns
param.split_patterns.description: Restricts this rule's checks/strategy to split tiles matching one of the listed patterns. Leave empty to allow any split tile shape.
param.patterns.label: Patterns
param.patterns.description: The declared split patterns a tile's current shape must match against (any rotation/mirror). Leave empty to disable this check.
param.allow_lose_connections.label: Allow losing connections
param.allow_lose_connections.description: If enabled, an existing connection not claimed by any new sibling node is dropped instead of failing the whole candidate.
param.allow_add_connections.label: Allow adding connections
param.allow_add_connections.description: If enabled, a new connection required by a sibling node's pattern face is added instead of failing the whole candidate.
param.split_config.label: Split settings
param.split_config.description: Whether to add split tiles matching a configured pattern list, or in unconstrained mode with a configurable node count.
quality.add_split_config.node_count_desc: Sets the maximum number of nodes for a randomly-shaped split tile. Used when no specific split patterns are configured on the rule's own pattern list.
quality.add_split_config.weights_descrip: Sets each pattern's selection weight, out of the pattern list configured on the rule — controls how often this pattern is picked when adding a split tile.
param.count.label: Connection count threshold
param.count.description: The connection count a split node's own count is compared against.
param.direction.label: Connection direction
param.direction.description: Which connections count toward the threshold.
param.direction.option.incoming.explanat: Only edges into the node count.
param.direction.option.outgoing.explanat: Only edges out of the node count.
param.direction.option.bidirectional.exp: Only neighbors reachable via a full two-direction passage count, one per neighbor.
param.direction.option.any.explanation: Every distinct neighbor with any connection, one-way or bidirectional, counts once.
param.split_teleport_direction.label: Teleport shape
param.split_teleport_direction.descripti: Which shape of teleport connection touching the split tile triggers this check.
param.split_teleport_direction.option.in: Fires if a one-way teleport leads into the tile.
param.split_teleport_direction.option.ou: Fires if a one-way teleport leads out of the tile.
param.split_teleport_direction.option.bi: Fires if the tile has a two-way teleport.
param.split_teleport_direction.option.an: Fires if the tile has any teleport connection at all — one-way in, one-way out, or bidirectional.
param.max.label: Max connections
param.max.description: The cap this check compares the connection count against.
param.min_detour.label: Minimum detour length
param.min_detour.description: The minimum path length two of the same split tile's nodes must be apart; a shorter path is flagged.
param.selection.label: Node selection method
param.selection.description: Which of a split's own nodes' connections to cut first.
param.selection.option.most_connected.ex: Cuts the connection whose originating node carries the most total connections.
param.selection.option.least_connected.e: Cuts the connection whose originating node carries the fewest total connections.
param.selection.option.merge.explanation: Merges every node's own connections into the one surviving node.
param.selection.remove_split.label: Kept node
param.selection.remove_split.description: Which of the tile's nodes keeps its own connections once the tile collapses to one node.
param.selection.remove_split.option.rand: Keeps a random node's connections, drops every other node's.
param.selection.remove_split.option.most: Keeps the connections of whichever node carries the most total connections.
param.selection.remove_split.option.leas: Keeps the connections of whichever node carries the fewest total connections.
param.selection.remove_split.option.merg: Merges every node's own connections into the one surviving node.
param.protect_original.label: Protect original node
param.protect_original.description: When enabled, the split's slot-0 (original) node's own connections are never chosen for removal.
param.priority.option.random.explanation: Removes a random element from the problematic set.
param.priority.option.problematic.explan: Removes whichever element belongs to the most other problematic sets.
param.priority.option.most_voluminous.ex: Collapses the split tile with the most total nodes.
param.priority.option.least_voluminous.e: Collapses the split tile with the fewest total nodes.
param.priority.option.most_connected.exp: Collapses the split tile whose nodes carry the most total connections.
param.priority.option.least_connected.ex: Collapses the split tile whose nodes carry the fewest total connections.
param.max_connections.label: Max connections
param.max_connections.description: Maximum number of outgoing connections allowed at the teleport's checked vertex before it's considered a super-hub.
param.max_connections.one_way_group_supe: Maximum number of one-way connections allowed at the checked vertex before it's considered a super-hub.
param.max_elevator_stops.label: Max stops per elevator
param.max_elevator_stops.description: The maximum number of stops a single elevator may have.
param.max_elevator_stops_per_floor.label: Max elevator stops per floor
param.max_elevator_stops_per_floor.descr: The maximum number of elevator stops, across every elevator, a single floor may carry.
param.elevator_stops_skip.label: Min elevator skip
param.elevator_stops_skip.description: The minimum floor-index gap allowed between two consecutive stops of the same elevator.
param.elevator_stops_span.label: Max elevator span
param.elevator_stops_span.description: The maximum floor-index gap allowed between any two stops of the same elevator.
param.min_elevator_count.label: Min elevator count
param.min_elevator_count.description: The minimum number of elevators the maze must contain.
param.min_elevator_density.label: Min elevator density (per 100 cells)
param.min_elevator_density.description: The minimum share of field cells that must carry elevators.
param.skip.label: Skip range
param.skip.description: The floor-index gap range allowed between two consecutive stops of a newly built elevator.
param.stop_count.label: Stop count range
param.stop_count.description: The range of how many stops a newly built elevator may have.
param.length_interval.label: Length interval
param.length_interval.description: The floor-index span range (gap between the first and last stop) a newly built elevator may cover.
param.min_stops.label: Min elevator stop count
param.min_stops.description: The minimum count of elevator stops (distinct floor-touches across every elevator) the maze (or a floor) must have.
param.min_stops_ratio.label: Min elevator stop density (per 100 cells)
param.min_stops_ratio.description: The minimum share of elevator stops relative to field size, expressed per 100 field cells.
param.existing_reuse_balance.label: Existing-reuse balance
param.existing_reuse_balance.description: Chance of reusing an existing elevator (adding it a stop) instead of building a brand new one; the other branch is tried as a fallback if the chosen one fails.
param.allow_span_extension.label: Allow elevator extension
param.allow_span_extension.description: When reusing an existing elevator on a specific floor, whether its current stop height may be extended, or restricted to filling a gap already inside it.
param.max_elevator_stop_gap.label: Max stop gap
param.max_elevator_stop_gap.description: The maximum allowed number of skipped floors between two consecutive stops of the same elevator.
param.min_elevator_height.label: Min height
param.min_elevator_height.description: The minimum required number of floors (inclusive) between an elevator's topmost and bottommost stops.
param.min_elevator_stop_count.label: Min stop count
param.min_elevator_stop_count.descriptio: The minimum required number of stops on an elevator.
param.allow_incomplete.label: Allow incomplete growth
param.allow_incomplete.description: When the stop interval can't grow to the full required width, still add whatever endpoint stops are available instead of skipping the entry.
param.balanced_growth.label: Balanced growth
param.balanced_growth.description: Alternate growing the stop interval up and down evenly instead of picking a random side each step.
param.max_compactness.label: Max compactness
param.max_compactness.description: Place new stops directly adjacent to the elevator's current top and bottom instead of anywhere on the floors beyond them.
param.expand_elevator.label: Expand elevator
param.expand_elevator.description: Whether new stops should be picked from floors outside the elevator's current range or between its existing stops.
param.expand_elevator.option.forbidden.e: New stops are only added between the elevator's existing stops; the whole entry is skipped if that isn't enough.
param.expand_elevator.option.discouraged: New stops are added between the elevator's existing stops first, falling back to floors outside its range only if that isn't enough.
param.expand_elevator.option.indifferent: New stops are picked at random regardless of whether the floor is inside or outside the elevator's current range.
param.expand_elevator.option.preferred.e: New stops are added outside the elevator's current range first, falling back to floors between its existing stops only if that isn't enough.
param.expand_elevator.option.required.ex: New stops are only added outside the elevator's current range; the whole entry fails if that isn't enough.
param.use_existing_elevators.label: Use existing elevators
param.use_existing_elevators.description: Whether the merge should reuse an elevator that already touches the region or the target floor by adding it a new stop, or build a brand-new two-floor elevator.
param.use_existing_elevators.option.forb: Only a brand-new elevator is built; the whole entry is skipped if that isn't possible.
param.use_existing_elevators.option.disc: A brand-new elevator is built first, falling back to reusing an existing one only if that isn't possible.
param.use_existing_elevators.option.indi: Reusing an existing elevator or building a new one is picked at random.
param.use_existing_elevators.option.pref: An existing elevator is reused first, falling back to building a new one only if that isn't possible.
param.use_existing_elevators.option.requ: Only an existing elevator is reused; the whole entry fails if none is available.
param.max_teleport_density.label: Max teleport density (per 100 cells)
param.max_teleport_density.description: The maximum share of field cells that may carry a distinct teleport portal, expressed per 100 field cells.
param.max_teleports.label: Max teleport count
param.max_teleports.description: The maximum number of distinct teleport portals the maze may contain.
param.cross_floor_balance.label: Cross-floor balance
param.cross_floor_balance.description: Balance between preferring a teleport exit on the same floor as its entry (left) or another floor (right). Only consulted while cross-floor mode is set to manual.
param.cross_floor_mode.label: Cross-floor mode
param.cross_floor_mode.description: Whether a teleport's exit may land on a different floor than its entry.
The exit is always on the same floor as the entry.
param.cross_floor_mode.option.natural.ex: Floor is ignored entirely — every node is an equally eligible exit regardless of floor.
param.cross_floor_mode.option.manual.exp: The exit's floor is chosen according to the cross-floor balance slider.
param.allow_cross_floor.label: Allow cross-floor teleports
param.allow_cross_floor.description: When on, a teleport may merge the region into a region on another floor. When off, the merge is restricted to regions on the same floor.
param.include_teleport.label: Include teleports
param.include_teleport.description: Count teleports among the element types the proximity check compares.
param.include_one_way.label: Include one-ways
param.include_one_way.description: Count one-way passages among the element types the proximity check compares.
param.include_vertical_passage.label: Include vertical passages
param.include_vertical_passage.descripti: Count vertical passages among the element types the proximity check compares.
param.include_elevator_stop.label: Include elevator stops
param.include_elevator_stop.description: Count individual elevator stops among the element types the proximity check compares. Two stops of the same elevator are never flagged as a pair; repair removes just the offending stop, not the whole elevator.
param.include_split.label: Include split tiles
param.include_split.description: Count split tiles among the element types the proximity check compares.
param.include_start.label: Include start
param.include_start.description: Count the start cell among the element types the proximity check compares. The start is never removed by repair.
param.include_finish.label: Include finish
param.include_finish.description: Count the finish cell among the element types the proximity check compares. The finish is never removed by repair.
param.search_mode.label: Search mode
param.search_mode.description: How the farthest-point search finds its candidate.
param.search_mode.missing_teleports.desc: Only takes effect when "Entry pick" is set to "Farthest from random". The exit node is always chosen from every eligible cell, corridor-interior or not, regardless of this setting.
param.search_mode.option.nav_graph.expla: Searches the nav graph, fast, but the farthest point can never be a cell inside a plain corridor.
param.search_mode.option.exhaustive.expl: Searches every maze tile, correct even when the true farthest point sits mid-corridor on a loop, at a higher cost.
param.exit_pick.label: Exit pick
param.exit_pick.description: How the teleport's exit node is chosen after the entry side and candidate distance zone are resolved.
param.exit_pick.option.random.explanatio: Picks a uniformly random node from the resolved zone as exit.
param.exit_pick.option.dead_end_priority: Prefers a dead-end node within the resolved candidate zone as exit, falling back to a uniform pick over the whole zone when none are available.
quality.nested_strategy.unconfigured_war: This strategy uses nested strategies, which can be configured on the rule's card.
quality.nested_slot.merge_target.descrip: The strategy that actually performs the merge between the picked regions.
quality.nested_slot.loop_seed_target.des: The nested strategy that actually seeds the missing loop connections.
analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.score_info_desc: How interesting and challenging the current start/finish route is. The score accounts for path length, junction count, one-way passages, teleports, elevators, and other special elements.
analytics.score_info_visibility: Only shown when the quality control's endpoint-fixing strategy is set to "Scored endpoints", since the score is computed directly from that strategy's own weight parameters.
analytics.no_route: No path from start to finish
analytics.region_class_alternative_desc: Can reach finish, but not on the shortest path
analytics.region_class_trap_desc: Reachable from start, but cannot reach finish
analytics.sides_info_desc: Adjacency between cells — shared edges between neighboring tiles on the same floor. Outer field walls and vertical connections between floors are not counted here.
post_edit.title: Post-Edit
post_edit.reset_tool: Reset to generated state (hold Shift to reset everything at once, without the picker)
post_edit.delete_tool: Delete an element (hold Shift to delete everything at once, without the picker)
post_edit.auto_confirm_info_p1: Confirming is what makes post-edit changes take effect and become visible in other menus.
post_edit.auto_confirm_info_p2: Auto-confirm applies each change immediately, without needing to press the Confirm button manually. However, every confirm recomputes the full analytics, so on large mazes this option can slow things down.
post_edit.auto_confirm_info_p3: For large mazes, it's recommended to turn auto-confirm off and confirm all changes manually once editing is done.
post_edit.auto_compact_info_p1: Auto-compact shrinks the log after every edit, removing entries whose effect was later overwritten. For example, if the start was moved several times, only its final position remains in the log.
post_edit.auto_compact_info_p2: This keeps the log shorter and leaves only the changes that still matter. The exact step-by-step editing history is lost, so the original sequence of actions may not be obvious.
post_edit.auto_compact_info_p3: Log size has virtually no effect on performance, so turning auto-compact on or off is purely a matter of convenience.

image_export.param_links.info_what: Parameter links let one setting follow another one's value automatically. When you change the source setting, every setting linked to it updates too, so you don't have to edit each one by hand.
image_export.param_links.info_how: Click "Manage links" to see all current links and add new ones, or click the chain icon next to a setting to link that setting directly. Pick which setting should be the source and which one should follow it. If you set a linked setting's value by hand, that value is what gets used, the link can't overwrite it.
image_export.param_links.info_modifiers: A link can also transform the value instead of just copying it. For example, you can link the marker border color to the marker fill color and add a modifier that darkens it, so the border always stays a bit darker than the fill, no matter what color you pick.
image_export.param_links.info_icon: The chain icon next to a setting shows its link status at a glance. A broken chain means it has no link, a solid chain means it's following another setting, and small arrow marks show whether the setting is a source for other links, a follower, or both.
image_export.param_links.info_visibility: The "Link icons" switch controls when the link icon is shown next to settings. If you've already set up all the links you want, or just don't need the link system, you can turn the icons off entirely, or make them less prominent by showing the icon only where a link already exists.
